source: Bring home the bacon with zero fees.
raw:
{
  "literal": "هات لحم الخنزير للبيت من غير رسوم.",
  "adaptation": "خلّي مكسبك كله ليك... من غير رسوم.",
  "back_translation": "Keep all your earnings for yourself—with zero fees.",
  "approach": "replaced",
  "notes": "The bacon reference was replaced because the English idiom does not translate naturally and pork is culturally inappropriate in Egypt."
}
literal: هات لحم الخنزير للبيت من غير رسوم.
adaptation: خلّي مكسبك كله ليك... من غير رسوم.
back_translation: Keep all your earnings for yourself—with zero fees.
notes: The bacon reference was replaced because the English idiom does not translate naturally and pork is culturally inappropriate in Egypt.
